rules: Before serialization, classify every discovered item as Bonus or Promo. A Bonus is only a signup/new-customer offer or an offer whose specific claiming/activation requires a new upfront deposit. Everything else is a Promo.

Existing-depositor, funded-player, VIP or active-customer status alone does not make an item a Bonus. A fresh deposit must be required for that specific offer unless it is a signup/new-customer offer.
Leaderboards, tournaments, races, prize draws, competitions, missions, giveaways and similar campaigns are Promos unless participation in that specific offer requires a new upfront deposit.
Reward type does not determine classification. Free spins, cashback, match rewards, prizes and other rewards may be Bonus or Promo depending on the signup/new-deposit rule.
Bonus JSON serializes only Bonus-classified offers. Omit Promo-classified items entirely from offers and schema_gaps.
schema_gaps is reserved only for genuine Bonus-classified offers whose mechanics cannot be represented by this contract. Never report a Promo-classified item as a Bonus schema gap.
One offer object represents exactly one market and one vertical. Multiple simultaneous offers for the same market/vertical are allowed.
Research prompts target explicit country/subdivision markets only and do not generate GLOBAL/ROW/international research targets. GLOBAL remains supported for legacy/import compatibility.

Offer titles use <Brand> <Market label> <Vertical> Offer • <Reward>, with concise editorial market labels such as GB=UK and CA-AB=Alberta. If the title would exceed 65 characters, omit <Vertical> first. Do not truncate verified reward text merely to retain the vertical label.
Market and currencies are independent. A USD-denominated poker offer may target GB, IE or another market.
Currencies use the canonical Bonus Offer ISO 4217 vocabulary. GLOBAL/ROW offers may use local currencies beyond Gamblee's detailed-market currencies.

One discrete promotion stays one offer even when the operator supports several account currencies. Use currencies as a list and do not clone an otherwise identical market/vertical offer solely for EUR/USD/etc. If structured mechanics materially differ by currency and cannot be represented exactly, report a schema gap rather than creating currency-only duplicates.

Match-bonus display copy is canonical. When components.match_bonus is enabled, copy.display_offer must be exactly <match_percent>% up to <currency><max_bonus_match> with no prefix or extra wording (for example 100% up to £100 or 100% up to TSh 20,000). Public offer copy uses the canonical currency symbol/display token, never the raw ISO code. Use the first currencies entry as the display currency; the importer normalizes this from the structured component values.
A multi-stage deposit pack is one offer. Capture all stages in multi_step.rows; structured reward components describe the first stage unless a future schema explicitly models later stages.
Recurring offers remain one offer and use schedule.weekdays and/or validity dates.
Do not output prohibited markets. CA-ON is currently prohibited for public Bonus Offer publication.

Use schema_gaps only when a genuine Bonus-classified mechanic is required for structured qualification, reward, wagering, cashout, schedule, eligibility or analyzer correctness and cannot be represented exactly. Ancillary restrictions that can be represented accurately in copy.terms, such as a maximum number of claims per month, belong in copy.terms and must not create a schema gap.
supported_and_analyzable and not_calculable offers may be imported. unsupported_but_fixable items are blocked until the schema is extended.

analysis.status is offer-level, but analyzer EV may be component-level. Mark an offer supported_and_analyzable when at least one substantive structured reward component is fully calculable. An unknown secondary component does not invalidate a calculable primary component; leave its unknown EV inputs null and exclude that component from EV.

Free-spin valuation default: when the operator does not state value_per_spin and every offer currency is one of EUR, GBP, USD, CAD, AUD or NZD, use 0.10 per spin. This is a Gamblee valuation assumption, not an operator-stated term. An explicit operator value always overrides it. Do not apply the 0.10 fallback to currencies with materially different unit scales such as ZAR.

With that fallback, a pure free-spins offer in EUR, GBP, USD, CAD, AUD or NZD can remain supported_and_analyzable when spin count is known. If value_per_spin is unknown in a non-default currency, leave it null and use not_calculable unless another component is calculable.

urls.offer is only for a Gamblee-approved/tracked commercial deep link. Never substitute a generic official brand website, ordinary promotion page, affiliate-programme homepage, evidence URL, or guessed tracking URL. Put ordinary official promotion pages in evidence and leave urls.offer null so Gamblee inherits the canonical brand market/vertical Commercial Link. urls.terms may use a direct official terms URL.

Use included_subdivisions when a broad country offer is available only in named subdivisions; use excluded_subdivisions when it applies broadly except named subdivisions. Never use both for the same subdivision.

Use included_countries only with market=GLOBAL to whitelist the exact countries covered by a broad international offer. Countries must already be confirmed for the brand or be proposed as evidence-backed country_additions in the same payload.
Use eligibility_devices only for real device restrictions. Empty means no device restriction.
Reward expiry values are paired with explicit units (hours, days or weeks). Legacy schema 1.0 payloads without units are interpreted as days.
taxonomy_additions may propose genuinely missing eligible_game, excluded_payment_methods or scoring_penalty terms. Structural vocabularies such as bonus_type and bonus_vertical remain locked.

brand_availability_changes may propose evidence-backed country or US/Canada subdivision additions/removals discovered while researching current official offer terms. Every change requires a reason and at least one first-party URL on a stored canonical brand domain. A country addition may include name; when a valid ISO code has no existing Gamblee Country record, the importer may create that Country record from the canonical name. Do not infer removals from the absence of an offer.
Offer validation may rely on an availability addition in the same payload. Availability changes are applied only after every Bonus Offer in the payload imports successfully.
A required but operator-selected or dynamically supplied promo code uses bonus_code_requirement=required_unspecified rather than inventing a code.
Use excluded_card_bins only when official terms explicitly list excluded payment-card BIN/IIN prefixes.
Use qualification_window_value + qualification_window_unit for a deadline to complete a qualifying action or use a pre-reward token; reward expiry remains component-specific.
When qualifying spend is defined as a multiple of a deposit or bonus amount, use qualification_spend_multiplier + qualification_spend_basis instead of guessing a fixed minimum_spend.

Use components.external_reward for non-cash third-party value such as vouchers or gift cards. Use components.free_rounds for branded game rounds such as Free Flights or Free Crossings rather than force-fitting them into free_spins.

Prefer current first-party/official brand or operator evidence for offer discovery, classification and mechanics. When first-party pages are unavailable, incomplete, geo-gated, login-gated or technically inaccessible, current specific secondary sources may be used for commercial offer mechanics. First-party evidence wins on conflicts. Do not infer facts from silence, and do not use secondary evidence for brand_availability_changes or regulatory/jurisdiction availability changes, which remain first-party-only. Label evidence clearly enough to distinguish official and secondary sources.
